summary: Alanna did not send a single message this week. That is the second zero-client week in three, and she has now been silent 12 days (last message 10/4, billing). Her last non-billing message was the 9/24 escalation, 22 days ago. ALTR sent 7 messages, and 3 were billing. Stephski sent a pre-withdrawal heads-up on 10/13, then invoice #5 (Oct 1-14) on 10/15. Invoice #5 went out on top of a ledger that is still unreconciled: no receipt has appeared in chat for #2, #3 or #4 (#4 was due 10/8, and Derrek sent the Zelle request on 10/4). Of the other 4 messages, 1 was Melissa's weekly leak update, which makes three consecutive weeks. Mayson posted the first written status update on this account in a while: the alannasworld.vip domain is 'back' on new infrastructure, with a request that she put it in her bio. Ollie Mckinlay resurfaced on 10/12 after 28 days of silence, but only to ask her to add someone on Snapchat. He addressed none of the backlog: her 5000+ photos, the sexting sets, the empty release calendar (48 days), the live-pause instruction, or the FAQ form. Still nobody has posted proof that anything was pulled from her own Drive/Dropbox (22 days), the Instagram account Michelle promised on 9/1 has no written proof after 45 days, and Michelle has been silent 35 days. CHURN WATCH, EXIT LIKELY IN PROGRESS. Last week's check was 'if she paid and went quiet again, treat as exit in progress'. She went quiet again, and her client asks fell from 1 (billing-only) to 0, against a history of 1-3 asks a week. Long-promised deliverables with no written proof (signal 3) are present. The owner's 30-day silence (signal 1) is not yet triggered: Derrek last posted on 10/4 (a billing Zelle request), and his last non-billing message was 9/24, so that crosses 30 days on 10/24. No ALTR message this week went back to her 9/24 complaint.

History: about 3, 1, 2, 1, 3 (2-week window), 2, 2, 1 (2-week window, billing), 0. This client was demanding and asked 2-3 things a week through 9/25. Going to zero after a complaint and a settle-up payment attempt is ALTR's documented churn alarm. (2) ZERO CLIENT MESSAGES for the second time in three weeks. Last message 10/4 (billing), last non-billing 9/24. (3) LONG-PROMISED DELIVERABLES WITH NO WRITTEN PROOF (churn signal 3, present): Drive/Dropbox ingestion (22 days), new IG account (45 days), alannaworldx0 takedown (73 days), release calendar empty 48 days, 'push heavy' customs (62 days). (4) BILLING SHARE: 3 of 7 ALTR messages were billing this week, and 8 of 17 since 9/25. That is close to half, but not a majority, so signal 4 is borderline and not triggered. (5) OWNER: Derrek's last message was 10/4 and was billing. His last non-billing message was 9/24 (22 days), so signal 1 is not yet triggered, but it trips on 10/24 if nothing changes. (6) RESULTS ANSWERED WITH A CALL OFFER (signal 2): not this week. Mayson gave a written domain update instead of a fourth call offer, which is a small improvement, but it was another ask of her ('Put it back in your bio'). (7) MONEY: invoice #5 was issued into an unreconciled ledger. #4 is 8 days past due if unpaid, and #2/#3 are 38 and 24 days past due if unpaid. Offsets that keep the score off the floor: the leak updates have run three consecutive weeks (the 8/12 'weekly reports' promise is now met), Ollie is at least alive in the chat again, the domain was re-delivered in writing, and invoice #5 carried no pause threat.
